tooSmall.title: Use a computer
tooSmall.body: HueForge needs at least 1366 × 768 pixels. Colours and layers are not workable on a phone or tablet.

light.intensityTip: How brightly the light shines in the preview simulation. Does not affect the print.

view.describeTip: Copies a text summary of the stack to the clipboard, ready to share.

mode.tip: A lithophane is backlit, filament painting is viewed from the front.

heights.layerHeightTip: Height of one printed layer in mm. Sets how finely colour can be tuned.
heights.firstLayerHeightTip: Height of the first layer in mm. Usually thicker for bed adhesion.
heights.heightStepTip: How many mm a height changes per arrow key or mouse wheel notch.
heights.notMultiple: Value must be a multiple of the layer height ({{layerHeight}} mm).

preview.label: Preview
preview.noImage: Load an image in the Source image panel and the model appears here.

drop.title: Drop an image here
drop.hint: Or click to pick a file, or paste from the clipboard with Ctrl+V.
drop.failed: That file could not be read.

probe.hint: Click the image to measure brightness and height.

library.name: Filament name
library.tdTip: Transmission distance in mm — how thick this filament has to be before it stops letting light through. Low means opaque.
library.empty: Nothing here yet. Try another tab or clear the filter.

calibration.title: TD calibration — {{name}}
calibration.lead: TD cannot be calculated, only measured. Print the step wedge, see which step hides the backing, and enter that number here.
calibration.backingHint: Best is an opaque colour with a low TD, usually black — it has to be obvious when it disappears.
calibration.stepsTip: How many steps the wedge has. More steps measure more finely and print for longer.
calibration.layersPerStepTip: How much taller each step gets. One layer per step measures most finely.
calibration.baseLayersTip: Layers of backing under the steps. Enough that the backing is not translucent itself.
calibration.summary: Wedge: {{width}} × {{depth}} mm, {{height}} mm tall · measures TD up to {{max}} mm
calibration.measureHint: Count the steps from the thinnest. Enter the first one where the backing no longer shows through.
calibration.noMeasurement: Enter a step number and I will work out the TD.
calibration.modelHint: The simulation's one free constant. Touch it only once TD is measured and the preview still disagrees with the print. Applies to every filament.
calibration.atTdTip: How much light still passes at exactly TD thickness. Lower means a sharper transition between colours.

file.title: HueForge — TD calibration wedge
file.howTo: Once printed, count the steps from the thinnest and find the first where the backing no longer shows through. Its thickness is the filament's TD — enter that step number in the calibration dialog.

empty.title: No filaments yet
empty.hint: Drag a filament here from the library, or add it with the + button on its row.

layers.tdTip: Transmission distance in mm. Changes the library too — it is a property of the material.

colorCore.showTdTip: Switches the column between simulated colour and each layer's TD.
colorCore.addSwapTip: Turns on adding a swap by clicking in the column.

size.widthTip: Width of the finished print in mm.
size.heightTip: Height of the finished print in mm, measured flat on the bed.
size.lockAspectTip: Keeps the loaded image's proportions so it cannot stretch.
size.cropToAlphaTip: The model takes the image's shape and leaves transparent areas empty. No effect on an image without transparency.
size.detailTip: Distance between mesh samples in mm. Smaller means finer detail and more triangles.

border.noneTip: Turns off the flat frame around the image.
border.widthTip: How far the frame reaches in from each edge, in mm.
border.depthTip: Height of the frame in mm. Must be a multiple of the layer height.

depth.baseTip: Solid slab under the relief in mm. Holds the model together at its darkest.
depth.maxTip: Total height at the brightest part of the image, in mm.
depth.dynamicTip: Rounds the max depth to whole layers so the top one is not cut in half.

brightness.srgbTip: Linearises colour before weighting it. Physically correct, but flatter mid-tones.
brightness.compensationTip: Gamma on the result. Below 1 lifts shadows, above 1 deepens them.
brightness.adjustmentTip: Added to every sample, moving the whole relief up or down.
brightness.smoothingTip: Blur radius in pixels. Kills noise and banding, but costs fine detail.
brightness.invertTip: Swaps light and dark. For lithophanes, which print the other way round.
brightness.fullRangeTip: Stretches the darkest and brightest spots across the whole height range.

statusBar.trianglesOverLimit: Triangle count exceeds the limit of {{limit}}.

common.notImplemented: This feature is coming in a later milestone.

compare.splitTip: Drag the line to compare the preview against the source image.
compare.overlayTip: Lays the source image over the preview at an adjustable opacity.

spotFix.brushTip: Turns on manual height touch-ups. Drag across the model; orbiting is off while it is on.
spotFix.strengthTip: A positive value lifts the spot, a negative one sinks it.

guide.title: First print guide
guide.lead: Four steps from a picture to a model your slicer can take.

image.title: Load an image
image.body: In the Source image panel on the right — drop it, click, or paste with Ctrl+V. Its brightness becomes the height of the relief.

filaments.title: Pick filaments
filaments.body: In the library on the left, hit + on the ones you own. Start dark at the bottom and work towards lighter colours.

swaps.title: Set the swaps
swaps.body: The sliders below decide which layer each filament starts on. The colour core in the middle shows what comes out.

export.title: Export
export.body: File → Export STL or 3MF for the slicer, and Export swap instructions as a crib sheet for the printer.

guide.calibrationNote: TD values in the bundled library are guesses, not measurements. Before trusting the preview's colours, measure your own filaments — the ⌗ button on each library row.

shortcuts.note: Shortcuts stay out of the way while you are typing in a field. Double-clicking the preview also resets the view.

about.body: A tool for preparing colour 3D prints from an image. Everything runs in the browser — your data stays with you and nothing is uploaded.

describe.heading: HueForge — model {{width}} × {{height}} mm, {{depth}} mm deep
describe.layers: Layer {{layer}} mm, first {{first}} mm, {{count}} layers total
